units.source_text: 这信系附在一枝大半凋零了的樱花上。

en.t: The letter was attached to a branch of cherry blossoms that had mostly withered.

units.source_text: 王命妇即将信送与皇太子看，并把信中情由告诉他。

en.t: Wang no Myobu immediately took the letter to the Crown Prince to read and told him what it was about.

units.source_text: 皇太子年方幼稚，但也郑重地阅读。

en.t: The Crown Prince was still very young, but he read it with solemn care.

units.source_text: 王命妇问他：“回信怎么说呢？”

en.t: Wang no Myobu asked him, "What shall we say in reply?"

units.source_text: 皇太子答道：“对他说：暂时不见，也就想念；何况远别，怎能堪忍？”

en.t: The Crown Prince answered, "Tell him this: even a brief parting makes me long for him; how could I bear a separation so far away?"

units.source_text: 王命妇想：“这答词太简率了。”

en.t: Wang no Myobu thought, "This answer is far too simple."
And she felt the child was deeply pitiable.

units.source_text: 她历历回思源氏公子为了与藤壶皇后做荒唐的恋爱而伤心落魄的许多往事，以及当时种种痛苦情状，

en.t: She vividly recalled the many past events in which Prince Genji had been heartsick and undone by his reckless love for Empress Fujitsubo, and all the anguish of those days,

units.source_text: 想道：“这两人本来都可无忧无虑地度日，只因自寻烦恼，以致投身苦海。

en.t: and thought, "Those two could both have lived their days free from care, yet they brought trouble upon themselves and plunged into a sea of suffering.

units.source_text: 然而半是由于我王命妇一念之差，从中牵线所致，思想起来，好不后悔！”

en.t: Yet half of it was caused by my own mistaken impulse, by my acting as go-between. When I think of it, how bitterly I regret it!"

units.source_text: 她回答公子的信上说：“拜读来书，但觉无言可答。

en.t: In her reply to the prince, she wrote, "I have respectfully read your letter, but I find myself with no words to answer.
I have already conveyed your wishes to the Crown Prince.

units.source_text: 其伤心之状，引人无限感慨。……”

en.t: The sight of his grief stirs boundless feeling. ..."

units.source_text: 这信写得不着边际，想是心情恼乱所致。

en.t: The letter was written in a rambling way, probably because her heart was in turmoil.
